jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(6)(E) inventory: Westfield School District, a town school district in the North Country Supervisory Union (member town: Westfield). Co-operates the Jay/Westfield Joint Elementary School (the joint board itself is out of scope); tuitions grades 7-12.

board.post_note: Westfield SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a), one 3-year seat elected each year from the floor at the annual school district meeting.

sources.note: Westfield Town School District Annual School Meeting minutes, March 3, 2026 (official): Art. 2 -- "Mary Gagne was elected to a three-year term (2029)" (nominated from the floor). The 2025 Town Report officials list publishes Kennison 2027 and Emery 2028 (Emery elected at the March 2025 meeting to a 3-year term, per the minutes printed in that report), and its roster line names the board: "Mary Gagne, Chair; Andrew Emery, Vice Chair; and Jessica Kennison." Clean build -- roster, terms, and the 2026 re-election all established from official town documents. (Westfield's separate Union Director seat for the NCUJHS/NCUHS boards drew no nominations in 2025 and 2026 and remains vacant; it belongs to those districts' files, not this board.)

directors.name: Mary Gagne
directors.note: Board Chair; re-elected March 3, 2026 to a three-year term (meeting minutes).
